privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.short: The camera picture never leaves your phone. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
privacy.recaptcha: This app is protected by reCAPTCHA; the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

camera.title: 📷 The camera
points: The front camera is used only while brushing, to follow your kid's head and mouth.
The picture is processed on your phone, frame by frame, and thrown away right after. No photos or videos are saved, and none are sent anywhere.
The face-tracking program runs on the phone. The first time, it may be downloaded from Google's servers; only the program file is downloaded, no pictures are sent.
You can always choose "Play without the camera".

stored.title: 💾 What we save
points: Your parent account: your name, email and how you sign in (Google or email).
Each kid's first name, favorite color, birthday (only if you add it) and difficulty.
Brushing results: times, points, streaks, stickers, items and which parent's phone was used or who logged a brush.
Prizes you create and when they were given, and who is in your family.
This is stored with Google Firebase, Google's service for apps.

who.title: 👨‍👩‍👧 Who can see it
points: Only the parents in your family. Another parent joins only with a one-time invite code you share.
Kids don't have accounts; a parent signs in on the phone.

errors.title: 🐞 Error reports
points: If something breaks, the app sends a short report: the error, which screen, the phone and browser type, app version and language, and a random account number.
Reports never include names, birthdays or brushing data, and are deleted automatically after 90 days.

notDone.title: 🚫 What we don't do
points: No ads, no tracking or analytics, no selling or sharing of data.
No contact with kids: no chat, no messages, no strangers.

google.title: 🌐 Other services
points: Fonts come from Google Fonts, and reCAPTCHA (Google) quietly checks that requests come from the real app, to keep the data safe. Both see your phone's internet address, like any website.
Voices were recorded ahead of time; nothing you say is listened to. The app doesn't use the microphone.

device.title: 📱 On this phone
points: Some settings stay only on the phone: language, spoken instructions and the tuning helper. In demo mode, everything stays on the phone.

delete.title: 🗑️ Deleting data
points: Grown-ups → Edit → Delete removes a kid and their whole brushing history.
Grown-ups → "Delete my account and data" deletes your account. If you're the family's only parent, all the family's data is deleted too; if another parent shares the family, the kids stay with them.

kids.title: 🧒 For kids
points: The app is meant to be used with a parent. Parents create the account and decide what's saved.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.alone: This deletes your account and all of your family's data: kids, brushing history, points, items and prizes. It can't be undone.
deleteAccount.shared: This deletes your account. The kids and their history stay with {{names}}. It can't be undone.
deleteAccount.google: You'll be asked to sign in with Google once more to confirm.

logNot.too_soon: Brushes need to be at least 6 hours apart.

how: 10 points for every finished brush (up to 2 a day, at least 6 hours apart).
+2 for each target hit without wandering off more than 3 times.
+5 for the second brush of the day.
A day with 2 brushes grows the streak. A 3+ day streak gives ×1.5 points, 7+ days gives ×2.
Treasure chests at 3, 7, 14, 30 and 100 days. +100 for a perfect week.
A shield (shop, or free at 14 days) saves the streak after one missed day.
Every 7 full days hatches a surprise baby dragon. 30 days unlocks the Golden Dragon.
Brushed without the app? Kids tab → "Log a brush". It counts like a regular brush, just without the steady-aim bonus.
Each week (Sunday to Saturday) has a mini-challenge, like brushing 5 evenings, for a bonus chest of 75–100.
Holiday items are in the shop only around the holiday (Jewish holidays follow the Hebrew calendar), plus summer and winter treats. On a holiday the dragon dresses up for the day.
Double points on the first day of each holiday, and on World Oral Health Day (March 20).
Add a birthday in Edit: the first brush of the birthday week opens a 50-point chest, and a birthday hat the first time.
Lost a tooth or visited the dentist? Tap the button next to the kid: they'll find a surprise chest (and tooth-fairy wings for the first tooth).
Every year of brushing with the app brings a 100-point anniversary chest, and a party cake the first year.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.help: Easy: a small nod reaches the corners and a little "o" breathes fire, with big targets and forgiving pauses. Hard: big head tilts and a wide-open mouth.

tuning.toggleHelp: On this phone only. Shows where the fire lands, how far the head turns compared with what's needed, and how open the mouth is. Use it to pick the right difficulty.
